name: Labelbox
desc: AI data platform you operate yourself, for training and evals
desc_zh: 由企业自建的 AI 数据与评测平台
solves: Training data cannot leave the company, so it cannot go to an annotation vendor. Labelling, grading, and evals come in-house.
solves_zh: 训练数据不能出公司，也就不能交给外部标注厂商。标注、评分和评测收回内部做。
best_for: When the training data has to stay inside the company and cannot go to an outside annotation vendor.
best_for_zh: 当训练数据必须留在公司内部、不能交给外部标注厂商时。
notes: The buy-not-outsource option when data must stay inside the company. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://www.cbinsights.com/compare/labelbox-vs-surge-ai
